thread:
tess (PM): Quick sync — finalizing the internal release note + announce for tomorrow's change window (US‑EAST 10:00–11:00). Deploybot will stage at 09:30. Need: one-line TL;DR, rollback criteria, and who gets the pinned note.
raj: Putting a short checklist here — we need a) model pin/version b) canary thresholds c) rollback trigger + owner. Without those ops won't sign off.
charlie (eng): Agree. Current pin is `r-infer-2.3.1` (quantized). Canary plan: 2% traffic for 20m, error rate > 5% OR 95th latency > 350ms -> rollback. Owner: me (charlie).
eli (docs): I'll take the release-note copy and produce a short internal announce + one-paragraph customer-facing blurb for CS. Propose we pin the internal note in #eng-releases and #support during the window.
sasha (oncall): Oncall will watch canary. If deploy-bot posts a failure, I'll escalate and triage. My rollback call window is first 30m unless charlie asks to hold.
raj: Suggest we add an explicit fallback model lane: if quantized variant fails, fallback to `r-infer-2.3.0-compat` (higher cost, stable). Add that to notes.
charlie (eng): Good call — adding fallback lane. Also added a small DB migration guard, so rollout has a hard stop if schema mismatch seen.
eli (docs): Draft internal blurb below — feel free to edit inline.

```
Internal release note (draft):
- What: Deploy r-infer-2.3.1 (quantized) to hosted inference. Improved prefix cache and latency optimization for short prompts.
- When: Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00 US‑EAST. Stage at 09:30 (deploy-bot). Canary 2% -> ramp.
- Who to notify: eng-releases (pinned), oncall, support-runbook, and CS standby.
- Rollback criteria: canary error rate > 5% OR canary 95th latency > 350ms OR deploy-bot returns non-zero health check. Rollback owner: charlie (eng). Oncall (sasha) executes immediate rollback if deploy-bot flags critical health.
- Fallback: if quantized path regresses quality, traffic will be routed to r-infer-2.3.0-compat automatically.
- Postmortem: brief post-check in #eng-releases within 2 hours after window.
```

eli (docs): I'll paste this into the internal announce and add a TL;DR line at the top. Also adding a direct link to the staging playbook.
raj: Tiny wording nit: change "improved prefix cache" -> "prefix/KV cache improvements". Also add a note about pinned tokens for the experiment.
charlie (eng): Updated in draft. Also adding metric to monitor: `kv_cache_hit_rate` and `generate.token_latency_ms.p95`.
sasha (oncall): Can we get the deploy-bot to post a short checklist before stage? Steps: LOCK schema -> STAGE -> RUN CANARY -> RAMP -> UNLOCK. If possible add `deploy-bot: preflight ok` message.
deploy-bot: staging scheduled by tess at 1764125400 (09:30 UTC). Preflight check queued.
tess (PM): Thanks team. Final asks: eli please publish pinned internal announce 30m before stage; raj please confirm CS standby email has the blurb; charlie please push final canary thresholds into the deploy target. I'll add a calendar event for the window.
eli (docs): Will publish pinned note at 09:00 and include a quick “how to read the rollback table” snippet.
charlie (eng): Canary thresholds committed. Also adding a short rollback runbook snippet to the pinned note: who runs `deploy rollback --to r-infer-2.3.0-compat` and who confirms.
raj: CS blurb drafted and sent to alex (CS lead).
sasha (oncall): I'll be at my desk for the window. If anything noisy appears I'll drop a one-line status in the thread. :thumbsup:
tess (PM): Perfect. After the window, let's have a 15-minute check-in in #eng-releases to confirm metrics and close the note. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
